options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.
options.doc_html_fr:

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.
options.doc_html_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

Full: s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

Minimal: s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Hidden Clamp Total Buffs
options.doc: Hidden option specifically for large sync/async creators to prevent gen errors
options.doc_fr: Option cachée spécifiquement pour les grands créateurs de sync/async pour prévenir les erreurs gen

options.name: Starting Debuffs
options.doc: The amount of "Debuff" perks you start with

options.name: Total Buffs
options.doc:
The amount of "Progressive Buffs" that will be in the pool
One buff is worth the opposite of a debuff
***WARNING*** If this is set too low for the logic to generate, it will throw an error!

options.name: Goal Region
options.doc: What region you have to reach in order to send the goal

options.name: Include Challenge Modes
options.doc:
Makes the individual challenge modes and their medals checks to be completed, 4 per challenge, for 24 total checks
Off: Turns off the challenge modes entirely
Open: Makes all challenges available from the start
Locked: Makes each challenge require a check to be accessible

options.name: Include Training Sector
options.doc: Adds training sector rooms to the location pool as well as an item check to allow you to enter it
options.doc_fr: Ajoute des salles du secteur de formation à la piscine d'emplacement ainsi qu'une vérification d'article pour vous permettre de l'entrer

options.name: Starting Trinket Slots
options.doc: The amount of trinket slots that you start with

options.name: Total Extra Trinket Slots
options.doc: The total amount of progressive trinket slot items that will be in the pool

options.name: Deathlink
options.doc:
Whether you want to play with deathlink on
Can always be changed in the client
'Unchanged' means it won't change the setting in the client upon first connection

options.name: Deathlink Amnesty
options.doc:
How many deathlinks you need to RECEIVE before you actually die
'Unchanged' (0) means it won't change the setting in the client upon first connection
options.doc_fr: Combien de liens de mort vous devez RECEVOIR avant de réellement mourir 'Unchanged' (0) signifie qu'il ne changera pas le réglage dans le client dès la première connexion

options.name: Free Disk Vendors
options.doc:
Makes all disk vendors free if enabled.
Can always be changed in the client
